notes.title: SherloCat in Rio de Janeiro
notes.notes:
[b]Rio de Janeiro through the eyes (and paws) of a very picky detective"
by SherloCat [/b]

Oh, it’s you? I hope you’re not just wasting time on the internet… But since you’re here, pay attention.

It’s me, SherloCat, the greatest (and grumpiest) feline detective in this hemisphere. I’ve been given a rather unusual mission: to explore the tourist hotspots of Rio de Janeiro. That’s right. Sun, sand, sweaty and noisy humans everywhere. A true test of my feline patience.

But I accepted. Why? Because mysteries can be anywhere — even under the sidewalks of Copacabana.

I’ve prepared 6 videos documenting my journey through this chaotic, charming city full of hidden stories. I visited the Christ the Redeemer, sniffed out secrets at the Arcos da Lapa, got myself (intentionally) lost in the Botanical Garden, followed clues in the Maracanã Stadium, nearly got into a fight with a seagull at the Sugarloaf Mountain, and of course, took a strategic nap near the Lakes Region.

Each video is a chapter in my investigation… or better yet, in this feline-cultural expedition.

If you have even a sliver of curiosity or an ounce of good taste, I suggest you watch.
Watch it, share it, and give me some credit. Being a detective in Rio isn’t for everyone… especially with that many pigeons flying around.

With suspicion and whiskers on high alert,
SherloCat.
